source_title: Ace Blend raises $9.91 mn in 3one4-led round - The Times of India
source_excerpt: BENGALURU: Nutrition brand Ace Blend has raised $9.9 million led by 3one4 Capital, with existing investor Fireside Ventures also participating.The company plans to use the money for research and product development, including new nutrition formats it expects to launch in the Jan-March quarter of 2027. It said it holds patents for these formats.Started by Shivam Hingorani, Ace Blend made its first sales in 2018. Saif Mehkri, who has nearly three decades of experience in the nutrition industry, joined as co-founder in 2022. Its range includes supplements aimed at heart health, immunity, sleep, recovery and brain health.Ace Blend said it controls ingredient sourcing, formulation and manufacturing.
